description: The chart illustrates the CoLeG-R values for different model scales in the LLaMA-2 family when scaling up the SFT dataset. The horizontal axis represents the model scales, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 in intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a model scale and containing four bars representing different SFT dataset configurations: "no SFT", "+ SFT on $D_0$", "+ SFT on $D_0$, $D_1$", and "+ SFT on $D_0$, $D_1$, $D_2$", distinguished by different colors and patterns as indicated in the legend. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, but the groups are ordered by model scale. The CoLeG-R values for the "no SFT" configuration are around 70% for all model scales, while the values for the other configurations are also around 70%, with slight variations. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar.
